author: implementation-agent

findings.summary: Quick Search uses an anchor with button ARIA instead of a native button.
findings.consequence: The trigger is keyboard-operable today through manual Enter and Space handlers, but the template duplicates native button behavior and can drift from expected control semantics as the trigger gains disabled state, form context, or future interaction changes.
findings.evidence: The owned template renders the Snabbsökning trigger as an `<a>` beginning at line 128, then adds `role="button"`, `tabindex="0"`, and manual key handlers on lines 130-136. The control has no `href`; it only opens `LazyQuickSearch`, and `app/assets/styles/nuxt.scss` already resets `.mainnav .quick-search-trigger` with button-like appearance rules.
findings.recommendation: Render this as `<button type="button" class="quick-search-trigger">Snabbsökning</button>`, preserving the ref, title, click handler, and focus restoration; then simplify the SSR assertion that currently requires an anchor with `role="button"`.
